section: Important policies and programmes of the Government of Andhra Pradesh - welfare and social security
subsections: AP delivery machinery and food access - secretariats, volunteers, P4, SERP and MEPMA, ration door delivery, Anna Canteens

accepted.s: Under the volunteer system associated with the Andhra Pradesh delivery machinery, one volunteer is assigned approximately to how many households?
accepted.x: The prescribed norm is one volunteer for every 50 households.
accepted.tq: Identify the exact numerical ratio rather than the broader institutional description.
accepted.sec: AP delivery machinery and food access - secretariats, volunteers, P4, SERP and MEPMA, ration door delivery, Anna Canteens  [GROUP-II]

accepted.s: The GSWS (Amendment) Bill, 2026 is associated with which of the following objectives?
o: Creating a separate pension authority for senior citizens
Replacing the Public Distribution System with direct cash transfers
Revising the roles of functionaries for Swarna Andhra 2047
Merging all Village Secretariats with municipal corporations
accepted.x: The GSWS (Amendment) Bill, 2026 revises the roles of functionaries in the context of Swarna Andhra 2047.
accepted.tq: Match the amendment with its stated institutional purpose.
accepted.sec: AP delivery machinery and food access - secretariats, volunteers, P4, SERP and MEPMA, ration door delivery, Anna Canteens  [GROUP-II]

accepted.s: The Zero Poverty P4 initiative of Andhra Pradesh was launched on which occasion and date?
accepted.x: Zero Poverty P4 was launched on Ugadi, 30 March 2025.
accepted.tq: Use the occasion-date association to distinguish closely spaced launch dates.
accepted.sec: AP delivery machinery and food access - secretariats, volunteers, P4, SERP and MEPMA, ration door delivery, Anna Canteens  [GROUP-II]

accepted.s:
With reference to the Zero Poverty P4 initiative, consider the following statements:
1. P4 stands for Public-Private-People Partnership.
2. It is run by the Swarna Andhra P4 Foundation under the Planning Department.
3. Well-off Margadarsis adopt poor Bangaru Kutumbam families.
4. Phase 1 covers 21.8 lakh families.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
accepted.x: All four statements correctly describe the P4 model, its institutional location, its adoption relationship and the phase-one coverage of 21.8 lakh families.
accepted.tq: Test a programme through its acronym, implementing body, beneficiaries and numerical coverage.
accepted.sec: AP delivery machinery and food access - secretariats, volunteers, P4, SERP and MEPMA, ration door delivery, Anna Canteens  [GROUP-II]

accepted.s:
Arrange the following developments in chronological order:
A. Introduction of e-Seva as integrated citizen service centres
B. Launch of Zero Poverty P4
C. Opening of 62 rural Anna Canteens at Dharanikota
D. GSWS (Amendment) Bill, 2026
accepted.x: e-Seva dates to 2001, P4 was launched on 30 March 2025, the GSWS amendment belongs to 2026, and the 62 rural Anna Canteens opened on 15 April 2026.
accepted.tq: Fix the earliest milestone first and then arrange the later 2025–26 developments.
accepted.sec: Universal angles

accepted.s: The Zero Poverty P4 programme is implemented by the Swarna Andhra P4 Foundation under which department?
accepted.x: The Swarna Andhra P4 Foundation functions under the Planning Department.
accepted.tq: Apply the ‘which department would do this job?’ institutional-authority test.
accepted.sec: AP delivery machinery and food access - secretariats, volunteers, P4, SERP and MEPMA, ration door delivery, Anna Canteens  [GROUP-II]

accepted.s: How many Mobile Dispensing Units were identified for door delivery under the Public Distribution System in Andhra Pradesh?
accepted.x: The Public Distribution System used 9,260 Mobile Dispensing Units for door delivery.
accepted.tq: Distinguish the exact service-delivery count from nearby rounded figures.
accepted.sec: AP delivery machinery and food access - secretariats, volunteers, P4, SERP and MEPMA, ration door delivery, Anna Canteens  [GROUP-II]

accepted.s:
Consider the following statements regarding Mee Mart in Andhra Pradesh:
1. It is connected with the modernisation of the Public Distribution System.
2. The National Cooperative Consumers’ Federation is associated with it.
3. One thousand outlets were planned, of which 553 were ready.
4. Goods were intended to be sold at ₹3–5 below market prices and linked to the Digital Rupee.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
accepted.x: Mee Mart was presented as a PDS-modernisation initiative linked with NCCF; 1,000 outlets were planned, 553 were ready, and the pricing and Digital Rupee link were specified as stated.
accepted.tq: Check a current programme through its partner, scale, pricing and technology features.
accepted.sec: AP delivery machinery and food access - secretariats, volunteers, P4, SERP and MEPMA, ration door delivery, Anna Canteens  [GROUP-II]

accepted.s: Which one of the following is NOT correctly matched?
o: Digital Rupee — linkage mentioned for Mee Mart
Anna Canteens — goods priced ₹3–5 below market rate
accepted.x: The ₹3–5 below-market pricing and Digital Rupee linkage relate to Mee Mart, not Anna Canteens. Anna Canteens are associated with a ₹5 meal.
accepted.tq: Separate two food-access initiatives by their distinctive price and delivery features.
accepted.sec: AP delivery machinery and food access - secretariats, volunteers, P4, SERP and MEPMA, ration door delivery, Anna Canteens  [GROUP-II]

accepted.s: A meal at an Anna Canteen in Andhra Pradesh is priced at:
accepted.x: Anna Canteens provide a meal priced at ₹5.
accepted.tq: Recall the flagship unit price associated with the programme.
accepted.sec: AP delivery machinery and food access - secretariats, volunteers, P4, SERP and MEPMA, ration door delivery, Anna Canteens  [GROUP-II]

accepted.s: On 15 April 2026, 62 rural Anna Canteens were opened at which place?
accepted.x: The 62 rural Anna Canteens were opened at Dharanikota in Palnadu on 15 April 2026.
accepted.tq: Combine the event date with its precise location.
accepted.sec: AP delivery machinery and food access - secretariats, volunteers, P4, SERP and MEPMA, ration door delivery, Anna Canteens  [GROUP-II]

accepted.x: The addition of 62 rural canteens took the total number of Anna Canteens to 269.
accepted.tq: Use the before-and-after programme total rather than only the number newly opened.

accepted.s: At the Collectors’ Conference held on 12 September 2026, which unit was identified for delivery of the Super Six benefits?
accepted.x: The family was treated as the unit for delivery of the Super Six benefits, with family mapping preceding the introduction of new pensions.
accepted.tq: Identify the administrative unit used for benefit delivery.
accepted.sec: Universal angles

accepted.s: What preparatory measure was associated with the introduction of new pensions in Andhra Pradesh?
o: Replacement of pensions by food coupons
accepted.x: Family mapping was to be undertaken before introducing new pensions.
accepted.tq: Translate the policy sequence into an administrative-scenario question.
accepted.sec: Universal angles

accepted.s: Which of the following best describes the criticism of “new welfarism”?
o: It favours direct benefit transfers and tangible transfers over public goods and may strain State finances.
It focuses exclusively on industrial subsidies rather than household benefits.
It prohibits the use of digital payments in welfare delivery.
It replaces all welfare schemes with public hospitals and schools.
accepted.x: The criticism is that new welfarism prioritises DBT and tangible transfers over public goods and places pressure on State finances.
accepted.tq: Distinguish the defining policy tendency from exaggerated or absolute alternatives.
accepted.sec: Universal angles

accepted.s:
Consider the following statements regarding social pensions and welfare delivery:
1. Kerala pays ₹2,000 per month as social pension.
2. Kerala is moving from doorstep pension delivery to Direct Benefit Transfer.
3. Andhra Pradesh spends the most per head on social pensions among the States.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
accepted.x: Kerala’s pension amount is ₹2,000 per month and its delivery is shifting towards DBT; Andhra Pradesh is identified as having the highest per-head social-pension spending among States.
accepted.tq: Use a comparison question to test amount, delivery mode and inter-State ranking together.
accepted.sec: Universal angles

accepted.s: The national e-Shram platform, launched in August 2021, integrates how many schemes?
accepted.x: The e-Shram platform integrates 15 schemes.
accepted.tq: Recall the launch period and exact integration count of a national platform.
accepted.sec: Universal angles

accepted.s: Which of the following was India’s first integrated citizen service-centre initiative?
accepted.x: e-Seva, introduced in 2001, was India’s first integrated citizen service-centre initiative.
accepted.tq: Apply the FIRST-in-sequence clue to distinguish an earlier service platform from later systems.
accepted.sec: Universal angles

accepted.s: Which one of the following statements regarding e-Seva is correct?
o: It was launched in 2019 as a village volunteer network.
It was launched in 2025 under the Zero Poverty P4 Foundation.
It was launched in 2021 to integrate social-security schemes.
It was introduced in 2001 as India’s first integrated citizen service centres.
accepted.x: e-Seva was introduced in 2001 and is recognised as India’s first integrated citizen service-centre initiative.
accepted.tq: Discriminate the earliest citizen-service platform from later AP delivery mechanisms.
accepted.sec: Universal angles

accepted.s: Which of the following correctly states the financial concern associated with Andhra Pradesh welfare commitments?
o: Debt is about 46% of GSDP, making all welfare delivery constitutionally impermissible.
Debt is about 36% of GSDP, contributing to concerns about fiscal strain.
Debt is about 16% of GSDP, with no concern about fiscal sustainability.
Debt is about 26% of GSDP and welfare spending has been eliminated.
accepted.x: The stated concern is fiscal strain arising in the context of debt of about 36% of GSDP.
accepted.tq: Select the precise fiscal figure while rejecting exaggerated percentage traps.
accepted.sec: Universal angles

accepted.s: The Opposition’s criticism of the Super Six programme included which of the following claims?
o: It was entirely implemented and pensions were increased without limit.
It was only partly delivered and pensions were cut.
It was confined exclusively to urban households.
It was replaced by the national e-Shram platform.
accepted.x: The Opposition alleged that the Super Six programme had been only partly delivered and that pensions had been cut.
accepted.tq: Distinguish a political criticism from the programme’s stated administrative design.
accepted.sec: Universal angles
